passive.name: Junkyard Titan
passive.text: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.

spells.name: Flamespitter
spells.text: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased.

spells.name: Scrap Shield
spells.text: Rumble pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage and granting him a quick burst of speed. While in Danger Zone, the shield strength and speed bonus is increased.

spells.name: Electro Harpoon
spells.text: Rumble launches a harpoon, electrocuting his target with magic damage, slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist. Rumble can carry 2 harpoons at a time. While in Danger Zone the damage and slow percentage is increased.

spells.name: The Equalizer
spells.text: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.

damage.value: Rumble deals sustained magic damage with Flamespitter’s three-second cone.

archetype.value: Rumble is a mage who damages enemies with flames and harpoons while shielding himself.

axis.value: Rumble can poke with Electro Harpoon’s 850 range and two carried harpoons.

spikes.why: Rumble enters Danger Zone, strengthening his basic abilities.
Rumble gains Attack Speed and bonus basic-attack damage but cannot cast spells for a few seconds.

bait.why: Rumble cannot cast spells for a few seconds while Overheating.

mistakes.value: Rumble gives up spell casts for a few seconds when he reaches 100% Heat.
